_comment: Wet look (core rg/wet_look.h): physics water film under the car (mm) and rain rate (mm/h) -> what the renderer shows. A road reads fully wet from a thin film already; puddles need standing water. Drop/flake density 1 at rain_full_mm_h (heavy rain); below snow_below_c the precipitation shows as snow. response_s smooths the change (the film is read under wheel 0 only, which jumps when it leaves the ground).

particles._comment: Rain / snow around the active camera (game/scripts/weather_fx.gd, presentation only): at most max_drops / max_flakes particles at density 1 (scaled by the graphics.rain_density setting), emitted in a box of box_m (x, y, z half extents, y up) centred height_m above the camera; streaks are drop_size_m (width, length), falling at drop_speed_mps; flakes flake_size_m, flake_speed_mps with flake_drift_mps sideways.
